In mathematical analysis, the '''characteristic variety''' of a [[microdifferential operator]] ''P'' is an [[algebraic variety]] that is the zero set of the [[principal symbol]] of ''P'' in the [[cotangent bundle]]. It is invariant under a [[quantized contact transformation]].

The notion is also defined more generally in [[commutative algebra]]. A basic theorem says a characteristic variety is [[involution (mathematics)|involutive]].

== References ==
* M. Sato, T. Kawai, and M. Kashiwara: Microfunctions and Pseudo-differential Equations. Lecture note in Math., No. 287, Springer, Berlin-Heidelberg-New York, pp.&nbsp;265–529 (1973)
